scripts.dev: npm run executor:build && concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @codebroo/web" "npm run dev -w @codebroo/server"
scripts.build: npm run executor:build && npm run build -w @codebroo/core && npm run build -w @codebroo/web && npm run build -w @codebroo/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @codebroo/core && npm run test -w @codebroo/server
